current.changeLog: Garage weekly MoE trend chart — the vehicle's mark tooltip now shows a "Last 7 Days" chart: one dot per battle on a percentile axis, horizontal mark lines at 65% / 85% / 95% / 100%, day dividers, and an end-of-day moving-average label for each day.

- fix: ensured the master switch correctly disables all optional reticles and indicators.
- fix: improved aiming-time updates during vehicle movement and turret rotation.
- fix: corrected several initialization, cleanup, and battle-state handling issues.
- mod: reworked the internal reticle management for better reliability and compatibility between the game clients
- mod: hide aiming information while statistics screens, pre-battle highlights, or the killcam are active.
- add: added Dual Accuracy cooling and active-state information to the aiming display. 
- add: added Dual Accuracy cooling information during WG replay playback.
- add: added and updated translations for Czech, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Singapore Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
- upd: updated dependency libs
